newsitem.title: UK: Eurostar hopes train will run in tunnel by midday.
newsitem.headline: Eurostar hopes train will run in tunnel by midday.

text.p: Eurostar said it hoped to get its express passenger train service running through the Channel Tunnel from London to Paris by midday on Tuesday.

A spokesman for Eurostar told Reuters that it was currently making arrangements for passengers to cross the Channel by ferry and then coach after Monday night's fire in the French end of the tunnel. "We hope to get something going direct from London to Paris by midday," a spokesman said.
Two people were seriously injured by toxic smoke and some 34 were evacuated when fire broke out on a shuttle train carrying trucks through the tunnel, closing it to all services.
